title: Portal invite entropy + allowlist orchestration with RBAC v2 and audit enrichment
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Replace ad-hoc invite behaviors with a deterministic, auditable orchestration layer that composes org-level allowlists/denylist, team-level overrides, and RBAC v2 role assertions. This ticket implements: 1) cryptographically strong ephemeral invite tokens (minimum 24 bytes entropy, rotating signing keys) and TTLs; 2) a deterministic resolution chain for allowlist/denylist (org -> team -> invite override) with clear precedence and admin-visible rationale; 3) audit log enrichment fields (invite_source, policy_applied, decision_trace, sso_assertion_id) so downstream compliance tools can reconstruct why an invite was accepted/rejected; 4) support for SSO-only orgs and SAML assertion checks during invite acceptance; 5) API and DB migrations to flag invites with rbac_v2_role_hint and invite_origin; and 6) a phased rollout plan with canary, metrics, and automatic rollback on error spikes.

Design trade-offs considered: 1) store decision_trace as structured JSON vs flattened string in audit log — chosen flattened key:value string to avoid nested fields in existing log ingestion paths, with a follow-up to expand to structured fields in logging pipeline; 2) TTL balance for invite tokens (shorter TTL reduces attack window, longer TTL reduces admin friction) — default 72h with org-configurable min/max and a recommend UX flow for reissue; 3) enforcement vs permissive modes for allowlist changes — implement permissive-by-default for first 2 weeks of rollout with audit-only mode to collect policy mismatches.

Success metrics: invite acceptance latency (p50/p95), failed-invite rate by policy mismatch, count of audit events enriched with decision_trace, reduction in manual admin support tickets for invite issues.
acceptance_criteria: Invite token entropy >= 192 bits and rotating signing keys deployed
Resolution chain evaluates org/team/invite overrides deterministically and logs policy_applied
Audit events include invite_source, decision_trace, and sso_assertion_id fields
Admin console surfaces the allowlist decision rationale for rejected invites
SAML orgs reject non-SSO invites when SSO-only feature enabled
Canary rollout runs for 72 hours with no >2x baseline error spike before full rollout
